profile.headline: Software Developer at California State University, Chico
profile.summary:
I hold a Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering with a minor in Computer Science from California State University, Chico, earned in May 2017. Since then, I’ve developed deep expertise in Enterprise Content Management (ECM) integrations, with a focus on secure infrastructure, system configuration, protocol troubleshooting, and connectivity across enterprise environments.

In my current position, I design, develop, administer, and support enterprise integrations across a diverse institutional environment that includes PeopleSoft CRM, Salesforce Educloud, Perceptive Content ECM, MSSQL and Oracle databases, and a variety of other systems used across campus. My background also includes hands-on experience in C/C++, JavaScript, and electronic form development using HTML5, CSS3, XML, and XSL. I also have working knowledge of Assembly, Java, SQR, Verilog, VHDL, and scripting with Windows CMD and Bash. I’ve supported embedded systems projects involving FPGAs, CPLDs, and ARM-based microcontrollers, including real-time applications using FreeRTOS.

I'm passionate about solving integration challenges, improving workflows, and increasing the performance and reliability of ECM platforms. I thrive in collaborative environments where technical precision and systems thinking are valued.

Outside of work, I enjoy embedded systems development. I’ve built several personal projects using C++ on Raspberry Pi and developed a home power circuit monitor with an STM32F7 Discovery board. This involved configuring ADCs, Hall-effect sensors, ISRs, mutexes, DMA channels, message queues, and a preemptive RTOS scheduler to capture and display real-time data efficiently.

To enhance productivity, I actively leverage large language models (LLMs) for tasks such as code generation, script debugging, documentation assistance, and exploring unfamiliar APIs or frameworks. This integration has significantly improved the speed and quality of my development workflow.

Specialties:
ECM integrations and troubleshooting • C/C++ • JavaScript • SQL (MSSQL, Oracle) • Systems scripting (Bash, CMD) • Embedded systems • Dell Boomi • PeopleSoft CRM • REST APIs • IIS/Tomcat administration • Real-time systems (ISRs, DMA, RTOS) • FPGA/CPLD (Verilog, VHDL) • CI/CD • Security and server configuration • LLM-assisted development

Certifications & Training:
-Dell Boomi Associate & Professional Integration Developer Certifications
-Dell Boomi Associate DataHub Certification
-Dell Boomi Professional API Design & Management Certifications
-PeopleSoft Integration Tools I
-PeopleTools I
-PeopleCode

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Current Responsibilities:

Administer and maintain the Enterprise Content Management (ECM) system, ensuring stability, security, and integration with institutional platforms.

Design and develop robust integration solutions using Dell Boomi, facilitating seamless data flow across enterprise applications.

Build, consume, and maintain RESTful APIs to support cross-platform communication and interoperability.

Troubleshoot and debug .NET applications (C#), improving application reliability and performance.

Manage and support IIS and Apache Tomcat hosted web applications, including deployment, configuration, and issue resolution.

Provide technical support and custom integration for PeopleSoft CRM, enhancing student and staff engagement workflows.

Lead support and integration efforts for Perceptive Content (ImageNow) and related Hyland products, including workflow automation and advanced scripting using iScript (JavaScript with C++-like syntax).

Perform complex query development and database support in MS SQL Server (SSMS) and Oracle SQL (PL/SQL Developer) environments.

Diagnose and resolve server, application, and network communication issues across development and production environments.

Oversee system and user-level security, including access control and role-based permission management.

Conduct thorough code reviews, system testing, and documentation to ensure quality and maintainability across projects.

Maintain assets, accounts, certificates, applications, and integrations in the organization's Configuration Management Database
positions.insights: Markup Languages, Analytical Skills and +7 skills

positions.title: Enterprise Applications Student Assistant
positions.description:
Developed and maintained automated document processing scripts within the Perceptive Content (ImageNow) document management system, streamlining high-volume workflows and reducing manual intervention.

Designed and implemented dynamic electronic forms using HTML, XSL, XML, CSS, and JavaScript, with back-end integration into MS SQL Server and Oracle SQL databases to support real-time data exchange.

Administered servers and managed user security, including access provisioning, role-based permissions, and compliance with institutional IT policies.

Engineered and tested workflow automation, document import routines, and custom web interfaces to enhance user efficiency and data integrity.

Built and maintained critical server-side services, scheduled tasks, and file share structures, ensuring reliable and secure content availability across departments.
positions.insights: Analytical Skills and Oracle SQL Developer
